researchThemes.title: Adaptive Machine Learning Systems
researchThemes.description: Building ML models that continuously learn from real-time data streams. Research focuses on self-improving neural architectures, low-shot learning, and model distillation to deploy efficient intelligence across edge and cloud ecosystems.

researchThemes.title: Natural Language Understanding at Scale
researchThemes.description: Advancing NLP beyond text prediction. We explore grounded reasoning, multi-agent dialogue, and zero-hallucination retrieval systems that combine symbolic logic with large-scale language models for trustworthy decision-making.

researchThemes.title: Perceptive Vision Intelligence
researchThemes.description: Developing vision systems with rich spatial understanding. Work includes 3D scene reconstruction, vision-language fusion models, multimodal memory, and generative perception engines for robotics, simulation, and creative tools.
